campo.editorial: Functional validation by the editorial owner (name, position, date and approval)

identificacion.descripcion: What is evaluated, where and with which tools.
identificacion.requerimientoAyuda: Type of evaluation, for example: initial web accessibility evaluation.

criterios.vistaColumna: How it will look in column J
criterios.sinCriterios: No criteria match this filter in the section.

hallazgos.descripcion: Each criterion marked "Not met" generates a finding. Complete the treatment plan: required action, severity, status, owner and due date.

severidad.critica: completely prevents finishing a main task or blocks navigation.
severidad.alta: causes great difficulty, but complex workarounds exist.
severidad.media: visual or usability inconvenience that does not block interaction.
severidad.baja: minor formatting or secondary markup detail.

hallazgos.vacio: No findings: they appear here when a criterion is marked "Not met".
hallazgos.limite: There are {{ n }} findings and the template allows {{ max }}: the first {{ max }} are exported in matrix order.
hallazgos.vistaColumna: How it will look in column C
hallazgos.ayudaTexto: Prefilled with the criterion observation; you can adjust it.
hallazgos.sugerida: Suggested by level {{ n }}; change it based on the real impact.

cierre.descripcion: Tools used, test results and final decision.

decision.conPlan: Authorizes with a registered improvement plan

resumen.exportarDescripcion: Fills in the accessibility matrix template: identification, status and notes for each criterion (with its evidence in column J), findings and closure. The summary and charts are recalculated when the file is opened.
resumen.aviso: {{ n }} criteria are not evaluated or have incomplete support. You can export anyway, but you should review them.
resumen.sinPlan: {{ n }} findings without a complete treatment plan (action, owner, date and status).

graficos.descripcion: The same charts as the exported .xlsx. They update as criteria are evaluated.
graficos.sinFallos: No criteria marked Not met yet.

respaldo.descripcion: Download all the records of a format as a .json file, or restore them from a backup.
respaldo.reglas: Restoring never overwrites: what was already loaded is skipped and what changed is created as a copy.
